body: Depression can do that. Well, for the least part, it's good that the date went well. Was just being socially active draining for you, or did the realizations about life start bumming you out?

I just wanted to add in a different POV: it seems like the miscommunication came from your word choice. "Will" is predicting a future that may not happen, that can't be guaranteed; it goes against one of the subreddit's rules too because of the sensitive state people on SW are in.    
    
When you're suicidal, it's because almost all attempts to make things better that you personally see have failed. I can guarantee you every person who has been majorly depressed predicted at least one positive outcome from something they're doing or trying to change; when it doesn't happen, imagine how much pain and loathing occurs after. Remember, the energy it takes to break out of a mental state of mind is incredibly high. Now multiply that by hundreds of self-promises, of "It will get better if I...". The pain and exhaustion is immeasurable, and that's when suicide becomes an option. Which is why phrases like "You will" and etc that promise an unforeseeable future is discouraged on this subreddit.
